agents.description: Agents whose runs the scorer samples. Each entry is an agent name or {name, includeDescendants}. Each name must be an agent of the definition, listed once.

includeDescendants.description: If true, the transcripts of all descendant runs are added as evidence.

harness.description: The harness of the judge run, over scorerDefaults and agentDefaults.

labels.description: Labels that the judge can give a run.

value.description: Name of the label. Unique in the scorer.

machine.description: Machine of the judge run. It replaces scorerDefaults.machine.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers of the judge run. They add to scorerDefaults.mcpServers. A server with the same name replaces the server of scorerDefaults.

model.description: Model of the judge run. Required unless harness is set. Without harness, the model name selects the harness. With harness, it replaces the model of that harness.

name.description: Name of the scorer. Unique among the scorers.

passingScore.description: Lowest passing score. At least one label must have a score at or above it, and at least one label a score below it.

samplingRate.description: Percent of finished runs to score, rounded to two decimals. 0 turns off automatic scoring.

secrets.description: Secret names of the judge run. They add to scorerDefaults.secrets.

selfImprovement.description: If true, the failures of this scorer go to Self-improvement.
